_doc: Lumi's unlockable designs (systems/designs.gd; looks in PatchModel.VARIANTS, add-ons in art/models/aurora/designs.glb). buff: a small themed bonus while worn: stat = an Economy stat id ("*.work_rate" = every robot type), research_speed (Research), or streak_grace (cleaning streak hold time); amount = +fraction. Off with flags.designs_looks_only. unlock.any: met when ANY condition reaches its target; cond types are the achievement ones (stat, research, list, flag, ...) plus fleet_tier (best robot fleet Mk index, 2 = Mk III). Stats nothing writes yet (wildlife_petted) simply stay 0. Unlocks persist in flags.skins_unlocked, the worn design in flags.patch_skin.

designs.name: Aurora
designs.desc: The seed-keeper fresh from the ark: pearl paint, cyan eyes, an orange fin.
